# Art license

All files in this folder (`candle-0.svg` to `candle-6.svg`, `arch.svg`, `frog.svg`, `flowers.svg`, `holder.svg`), `favicon.svg` and `og.png` were drawn for Everlight Garden as original vector art in this repository. They are released under CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication). No third-party image, font or icon was copied. The wallet marks in `src/components/walletIcons.ts` are the vendors' own marks, used only to identify each wallet, as distributed by RainbowKit (MIT).
